phrase-welcome.def: what you say to greet a guest who has just arrived

phrase-good-afternoon.def: a polite greeting you say to someone after midday and before evening

phrase-hi.def: a short, friendly way to greet someone you know well

phrase-pardon.def: what you say when you did not hear someone and want them to say it again

phrase-no-thank-you.def: a polite way to refuse something that someone offers you

phrase-yes-please.def: a polite way to accept something that someone offers you

phrase-its-okay.def: what you say to tell someone that a mistake or problem is not serious

phrase-dont-worry.def: what you say to calm someone who feels nervous or afraid

phrase-take-care.def: a friendly thing to say when you are leaving, wishing the other person safety and health

phrase-have-a-nice-day.def: a friendly wish said when you part from someone, usually during the daytime

phrase-same-to-you.def: what you say to return a good wish that someone has just given you

phrase-bless-you.def: what you say to a person who has just sneezed

phrase-get-well-soon.def: a kind wish for someone who is sick or hurt, hoping they recover quickly

phrase-happy-birthday.def: a wish you say to someone on the yearly date of their birth

phrase-congratulations.def: what you say to praise someone for a success or good news

phrase-merry-christmas.def: a holiday wish said around the twenty-fifth of December

phrase-happy-new-year.def: a wish said around the first of January, when the calendar starts again

phrase-long-time-no-see.def: what you say when you meet someone again after many months or years

phrase-i-am-fine.def: a common answer when someone asks how you are, saying you feel well

phrase-and-you.def: what you ask to return the same question to the person who just asked you

phrase-do-you-speak-english.def: a question you ask to find out whether a person can communicate in this common world language

phrase-i-speak-a-little.def: what you say to tell people you know only some words of a language

phrase-can-you-repeat.def: a polite request asking a speaker to say their words again

phrase-speak-slowly.def: a polite request asking a person to talk at a lower speed so you can understand

phrase-what-does-it-mean.def: a question you ask when you do not understand a word or sign

phrase-how-do-you-say.def: a question you ask to learn the word for something in a language

phrase-can-you-write-it.def: a polite request asking someone to put words on paper so you can read them

phrase-i-am-learning.def: what you say to explain that you are studying something and are not yet good at it

phrase-i-need-help.def: what you say when you have a problem and want someone to assist you

phrase-i-am-lost.def: what you say when you do not know where you are or which way to go

phrase-where-is.def: a question you ask to find the position of a place or thing

phrase-how-do-i-get-to.def: a question you ask to learn the route to a place

phrase-is-it-far.def: a question you ask to find out whether a place is a long distance away

phrase-call-ambulance.def: an urgent request to phone for emergency medical transport

phrase-call-police.def: an urgent request for someone to phone officers because of a crime or danger

phrase-fire-alarm.def: a loud warning shouted when flames and smoke are spreading in a building

phrase-i-feel-bad.def: what you say to tell someone that you are ill or in poor health

phrase-it-hurts-here.def: what you say to a doctor while pointing to the place on your body where you feel pain

phrase-i-am-allergic.def: what you say to warn people that a certain food or substance makes you sick

phrase-leave-me-alone.def: an angry or firm demand that someone stop bothering you

phrase-i-would-like.def: a polite way to say what you want when ordering or asking for something

phrase-can-i-pay-by-card.def: a question asking a seller whether you may settle the cost without cash

phrase-the-bill-please.def: what you say to a waiter when you have finished eating and want to pay

phrase-table-for-two.def: what you say at a restaurant door to ask for seats for yourself and one other person

phrase-i-am-vegetarian.def: what you say to explain that you do not eat meat or fish

phrase-just-looking.def: what you tell a shop assistant when you do not want to buy anything yet

phrase-do-you-have.def: a question you ask to find out whether a seller or person can give you something

phrase-too-expensive.def: what you say when the price is higher than you want to pay

phrase-ill-take-it.def: what you say to a seller to show that you decide to buy the item

phrase-can-i-try-it-on.def: a question you ask in a clothing shop to see if you may wear something before buying

phrase-where-can-i-buy.def: a question you ask to find out which shop sells a certain thing

phrase-it-was-delicious.def: what you say to compliment the cook after a tasty meal

phrase-one-ticket-to.def: what you say at a counter to buy a travel pass for a certain destination

phrase-when-does-it-leave.def: a question you ask about the departure time of a bus, train or plane

phrase-which-platform.def: a question you ask at a station to find where your train departs from

phrase-is-this-seat-free.def: a question you ask before sitting down next to a stranger

phrase-i-have-a-reservation.def: what you say at a hotel or restaurant to show that you booked in advance

phrase-wifi-password.def: a question you ask to get the secret code for connecting to a wireless internet network

phrase-what-time-does-it-open.def: a question you ask about the hour when a shop or museum starts to receive visitors

phrase-what-do-you-do.def: a question you ask to find out what job someone has

phrase-how-old-are-you.def: a question you ask to learn how many years a person has lived

phrase-i-live-in.def: what you say to tell the city or country where your home is

phrase-i-am-from.def: what you say to tell the place where you were born or grew up

phrase-lets-go.def: what you say to suggest that a group start moving or leave now

phrase-wait-a-moment.def: a polite request asking someone to stay or pause for a short time

phrase-i-agree.def: what you say to show you have the same opinion as someone else

phrase-i-think-so.def: what you say when you believe something is probably true

phrase-i-dont-think-so.def: what you say when you believe something is probably not true

phrase-really-question.def: what you say to show you are surprised by what someone told you

phrase-what-happened.def: a question you ask when you see that something unusual or bad took place

phrase-never-mind.def: what you say to tell someone to forget what you said or that a problem is not important

phrase-it-doesnt-matter.def: what you say when a choice or mistake is not important

phrase-good-idea.def: what you say to show that you like a suggestion

phrase-be-careful.def: a warning to someone to avoid danger or mistakes

phrase-hurry-up.def: what you say to tell someone to move or act faster

phrase-come-in.def: what you say to invite someone to enter a room or house

phrase-help-yourself.def: what you say to invite a guest to take food or drink without asking

phrase-do-your-best.def: what you say to encourage someone to try as hard as they can

phrase-see-you-tomorrow.def: what you say when leaving someone you will meet again the next day

phrase-well-done.def: what you say to praise someone who did something successfully

phrase-i-love-you.def: what you say to someone you have deep romantic or family feelings for

phrase-i-miss-you.def: what you say to someone you are apart from, to say you wish they were with you

phrase-what-is-this.def: a question you ask to learn the name or purpose of an object you point at

phrase-itadakimasu.gl: itadakimasu: Japanese phrase said before a meal to thank for the food

phrase-gochisousama.gl: gochisōsama: Japanese phrase said after a meal to thank for it

phrase-thanks-for-hard-work.gl: otsukaresama: East Asian phrase thanking someone for their effort at work

phrase-kolay-gelsin.gl: kolay gelsin: Turkish "may it be easy", said to someone at work

phrase-kalo-mina.gl: kalo mina: Greek "good month", said on the first day of a month

phrase-s-lyogkim-parom.gl: s legkim parom: Russian "with light steam", said to someone after a bath or sauna

phrase-kezcsokolom.gl: Kezét csókolom: Hungarian "I kiss your hand," a respectful greeting to women or elders

phrase-have-you-eaten-yet.gl: Ăn cơm chưa?: Vietnamese "Have you eaten yet?", a caring everyday greeting
